_meta.description: SYX Design System — Executable rule contract. The single source of truth for what scripts/lib/rules.js checks: severities, allowed paths, matchers and the inline-exception mechanism all come from here. Run by scripts/syx-validate.js (whole tree), validate_snippet (MCP) and the C1 criterion of the mode evals.

severities.error: Must be fixed before release. Breaks token contract or introduces technical debt.
severities.warning: Should be fixed. Indicates misalignment between source and runtime.
severities.info: Informational. Catalogued but no blocking action required.

engine.description: Rules with a `match` are checked on the AST (postcss-scss), not line by line: declarations nested or on one line, `@include` parameters, and comments (never inspected). Strings inside values are ignored for R01/R02.

allowedIn.semantics: A path ending in `/` allows a whole layer; any other entry is a single file.
allowedIn.why: A single-file allowance that no longer excuses anything is a hole: the next violation in that file passes unseen. On a whole-tree run, a file entry that excuses nothing (or does not exist) is reported under R10.

exceptions.placement: On the line immediately before the declaration or @include it excuses.
exceptions.covers: Exactly one declaration or body-less at-rule. Never a block, never a file.
exceptions.why: Whole-file exemptions hid what they did not mean to: files exempted for one line kept their exemption after the line was gone, and new violations in them passed unseen. A line-level exception carries its reason next to the code and dies (as an R10 error) when the code it excused changes.

rules.description: No --primitive-* tokens outside the layers that define or translate them (atoms/, molecules/, organisms/, layout/, pages/, site/ and any other path not in allowedIn)
rules.resumen: Un componente no usa --primitive-* directamente: pasa por --semantic-*
rules.rationale: Primitive tokens are raw values. Components must always go through --semantic-* or --component-* to enable theming.

rules.resumen: Sin !important — la cascada se gobierna con @layer
rules.rationale: SYX uses @layer for cascade management. !important is never needed and indicates a layer assignment error.

rules.description: No raw `transition` or `transition-*` property (any vendor prefix, nested or longhand) — use @include transition()
rules.resumen: Sin `transition` ni `transition-*` en crudo — usa el mixin transition()
rules.rationale: The @include transition() mixin automatically adds prefers-reduced-motion guard. Raw transition: skips this.

rules.description: No raw `position: absolute`, `position: fixed`, or `position: sticky` — use SYX positioning mixins
rules.resumen: Sin `position: absolute|fixed|sticky` en crudo — usa los mixins de posición
rules.rationale: Positioning mixins are null-safe and consistent. Raw position declarations bypass the null-safe pattern.

rules.description: Component tokens defined in SCSS should be registered in tokens.json
rules.rationale: tokens.json is the source-of-truth documentation. Undocumented tokens are invisible to AI tooling.

rules.description: Tokens documented in tokens.json should appear in the compiled CSS runtime
rules.rationale: A token that exists in documentation but not in CSS output is a phantom token. AI suggestions using it will fail at runtime.

rules.description: CSS custom properties without an official SYX prefix (--primitive-*, --semantic-*, --component-*, --theme-*, --icon-*, --layout-*, --reset-*) must be catalogued
rules.rationale: Unprefixed variables are invisible to the AI contract layer and may be legacy, local, or from an external source.

rules.description: Semantic and component tokens in the registry should be used by at least one compiled stylesheet (measured on css/*.css, where Sass interpolation is already resolved; primitive ramps are palettes and are not counted)
rules.rationale: Tokens that are defined but never used are candidates for removal. Dead tokens add noise to AI context.

rules.description: Every @include names a mixin the system defines (any @mixin under scss/, or in the snippet itself)
rules.resumen: Cada @include llama a un mixin que existe
rules.rationale: An @include of a mixin that does not exist fails to compile — or worse, in a snippet nobody compiles, it looks like compliance. R03/R04 push authors towards mixins; this rule makes sure the mixin they reach for is real.

rules.description: Every exception is justified and alive: a `syx-allow` directive is well-formed, sits right before one declaration, names a rule that allows inline exceptions, and excuses a real violation; every single-file allowedIn entry exists and excuses something
rules.resumen: Toda excepción está justificada y excusa algo real
rules.rationale: A dead exception is a pre-signed pass for the next violation in the same place.

knownLegacyOrigins.note: If a legacy var is identified, investigate its origin before migrating. Possible sources: historical SYX files, external CSS resets, or theme builder artifacts.
